scope.initialHistoryLength: Every page is created as Playwright about:blank and navigated once with page.goto; initial history.length is recorded without deleting that first entry.
scope.caching: All HTTP responses use Cache-Control: no-store. Playwright/Chromium automation default flags are recorded because BFCache may be disabled by automation.
scope.tlsAndFrames: TLS, subframes, shadow DOM, and framework integration were not tested.
scope.opaqueOrigins: The blob: history URL case is included; sandboxed/other opaque-origin frames were not tested.
